The balance sheet shows adequate near-term liquidity (current ratio 1.39) and a meaningful equity base, but leverage is still substantial with liabilities at about 71% of assets and operating profitability relatively modest (EBIT of 886M on 73,988M of assets). With retained earnings at zero and only moderate earnings cushion, this looks more like a lower-tier investment-grade credit than a strongly capitalized issuer.

DECISION: BBB-
